portlet.name: S4VP My Payroll (portlet)
portlet.description: Employee Center / dashboard portlet: a light header plus the self-service portal overview (customscript_s4vp_sl_my_payroll, view=dashboard, embed=1) in an iframe. Runs as the viewer (no run-as role) and reads no payroll record; the embedded Suitelet filters every query by the logged-in employee.
